messages:
Olivia: FYI we're doing a pre-onboard for CipherLane tomorrow 9:30am PT. Focus: SAML/SSO nameID format, SCIM group sync behavior, BYOK wrapping into our KMS, and marketplace compliance text. Need owners for each check.

Ravi: I'll take SAML + SCIM. Ask partner for their SAML metadata (entityID, ACS URL, cert) and a sample assertion. For SCIM: do they push groups or do we pull? Also prefer SCIM PATCH support for group changes.

Jules: Security owning BYOK/HSM validation. Requirements: partner provides public wrapping key (PEM), cert chain, HSM vendor + attestation. Preferred wrapping algos: RSA-OAEP-256 or ECDH-ES. If their HSM isn't FIPS, we'll list compensating controls. Need staging key for import test.

Ava: Legal: embargo window must be confirmed. We'll need logo usage rights and quote approvals. If partner requests SOC2 language, we'll add an NDA amendment; estimate 2 business days to draft once they sign.

ops-bot: Onboarding doc created: https://internal/partners/cipherlane/onboard. Please update SCIM/SAML/KMS checklist.

Ravi: Quick sample curl for SCIM create to validate format:
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users -d '{"userName":"mchung","name":{"givenName":"Maya","familyName":"Chung"},"emails":[{"value":"mchung@cipherlane.com"}]}'

Jules: Rotation policy: partner keys must support rewrap without breaking tokens. We'll run a rotation test in staging: import, wrap, rotate, unwrap. ETA for security sign-off: 3 business days after artifacts received.

Olivia: Timeline proposal: canary on Dedicated in 10 days, marketplace tile + blurb in 3 weeks post-canary. @Ava please confirm embargo constraints.

Ava: Confirming embargo: need final draft 4 business days before public. Send quotes to legal-marketing@redwood.ai.

Ravi: I'll draft a minimal README for the marketplace tile showing SAML->SCIM->KMS flow and attach a sequence diagram. Partner: please confirm nameID format (email vs persistent) and whether they sign with SHA-256.

Olivia: Great. I'll collect artifacts in /projects/partners/cipherlane and kick off calendar invite. Post blockers here before EOD. Thanks! :thumbsup:
